```{r}
stem_clusters <- c("7", "8")
srt_sub <- subset(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, 
                  sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.5 %in% stem_clusters & Phase == "G1")
gene_detection <- Matrix::rowSums(GetAssayData(srt_sub, "RNA", layer = "counts")>=1)
srt_sub <- srt_sub[gene_detection>=10,]

```

```{r}
options(future.globals.maxSize = 8 * 1024^3)
srt_sub <- srt_sub %>% 
  SCTransform(assay = "RNA",) %>% 
  RunPCA(assay = "SCT") %>%
   FindNeighbors(dims = 1:10) %>%
   FindClusters(resolution = c(0.5,0.9)) %>%
   RunUMAP(dims = 1:10,
           min.dist = 0.05, 
           n.neighbors = 15)

```

```{r}
srt_sub <- Seurat::RunICA(srt_sub)
```

```{r}
ferchen_annot_df <- proj_ferchen_26_mm_bm_hsc[colnames(srt_sub),
                                                 str_subset(colnames(proj_ferchen_26_mm_bm_hsc), "pred|mapping")]
srt_sub <- AddMetaData(srt_sub, 
                       ferchen_annot_df)
srt_sub@meta.data  <- srt_sub@meta.data %>%
    rownames_to_column("cell.id") %>% 
    group_by(predicted.Level4)%>%
    mutate(n = dplyr::n()) %>%
    ungroup() %>% 
    mutate(predicted.Level4_other = ifelse(n<20, "others", predicted.Level4))%>%
    as.data.frame() %>% 
      column_to_rownames("cell.id")
    
```

srt_sub <- AddMetaData(srt_sub, proj_zeng_25_hs_bm_hsc[colnames(srt_sub),c("predicted.CellType_Broad"),drop = FALSE])

```{r}

stem_clusters <- c("7", "8")
srt_sub <- subset(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, 
                  sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.5 %in% stem_clusters & Phase == "G1")
gene_detection <- Matrix::rowSums(GetAssayData(srt_sub, "RNA", layer = "counts")>=1)
rna_counts <- GetAssayData(srt_sub, "RNA", layer = "counts")[gene_detection>=10,]
rna_counts[rna_counts>=1] <- 1

options(future.globals.maxSize = 8 * 1024^3)
srt_sub <- srt_sub %>% 
  SCTransform(assay = "RNA",) %>% 
  RunPCA(assay = "SCT") %>%
   FindNeighbors(dims = 1:10) %>%
   FindClusters(resolution = c(0.5,0.9)) %>%
   RunUMAP(dims = 1:10,
           min.dist = 0.05, 
           n.neighbors = 15)





```

```{r}
rna_counts <- GetAssayData(srt_sub, "RNA", layer = "counts")
rna_counts[rna_counts>=1] <- 1

glmPCA_coa<- glmpca::glmpca(rna_counts[VariableFeatures(srt_sub,nfeatures = 1000),],
                            L=10,
                            fam="poi")
glmPCA_coa$factors %>% 
    mutate(grp = srt_sub$sample.name[rownames(.)]) %>%
    ggplot(aes(dim1, dim3, color = grp))+
    geom_point(size=0.5)
glmPCA_coa$factors %>% 
    mutate(grp = srt_sub$sample.name[rownames(.)]) %>%
    ggplot(aes(dim3, dim5, color = grp))+
    geom_point(size=0.5)
srt_sub[["pca_"]] <- Seurat::CreateDimReducObject(mc_umap_coords %>% column_to_rownames("metacell_id") %>% as.matrix(),key = "UMAP")

```
